objective: Implement and measure one opt-in title-first metadata grouping change against a real application baseline with synthetic provider responses.
authorization: User explicitly requested continuation after updating Docker and approved downloading Go. This is a new bounded scope after the closed source assessment, not a retry of its exhausted setup campaign.
hypothesis: Eligible five-field metadata generation can use two application LLM calls rather than five while preserving controlled outputs and existing behavior outside eligibility.
change: Local opt-in grouped generation for tags, correspondent, document type and created date after title; retain existing path for excluded configurations and bounded fallback.
eligibility: Loaded standard templates match locked defaults
Nonempty tag, correspondent and document-type candidates
Token limiting disabled in initial implementation; token-limited configurations retain baseline

workload.firstPair: One synthetic invoice; baseline five-standard path first, then same fixture candidate; no larger matrix until pair complete

fixture.title: Original synthetic invoice
fixture.content: SYNTHETIC-DOC-001. Vendor issued invoice SYN-001 on 2026-09-01 for 42.00 USD. This is synthetic benchmark data, not a real customer document.

qualityGuardrails: Baseline and candidate full DocumentSuggestion must match frozen expected fixture fields
Generated title must reach grouped prompt
No application-level grouped retries; one failed grouped attempt plus four baseline tail calls gives six total, or abort on baseline error
All excluded configurations preserve baseline outputs and call structure
Strict grouped response validation; no silently accepted missing fields
Record all prompts, responses and errors; fake provider success is not live quality
Keep same source and harness hash per comparison; raw results immutable

measurement.latency: Local fake-provider elapsed time only; not service performance

economicRationale: At unchanged acceptance whole-workflow benefit = metadata cost share * metadata-stage reduction - added runtime and amortized engineering burden. All money inputs unknown; no savings claim from request counts.

decisionRules.keep: First pair meets output/call gates, boundary tests pass and narrow opt-in implementation remains maintainable; keep locally experimental only
decisionRules.reject: Executed comparison violates unchanged acceptance or meaningful benefits disappear
decisionRules.park: Execution prerequisite or recovery limit prevents a supported code decision

outOfScope: Automatic follow-up campaign after this experiment
